# Bitcoin Mining Pools Dashboard

Static no-build-step web dashboard hosted on GitHub Pages (`dashboard/`) visualizing Bitcoin mining pool dominance, HHI concentration, sourced pool profiles, and post-2021 forensics.

## Architecture
1. **Upstream Dataset & Pipeline (`mining-pools-data`)**: Generates the versioned registry, yearly block attribution Parquets (`host_pool` and sub-pool `pool`), 182 sourced pool profiles (`pool_profiles.json`), and forensics metrics (`forensics_data.json`), then syncs site payloads into `dashboard/data/` via `scripts/sync_to_site.py`.
2. **Static Dashboard (`dashboard/`)**: Reads `blocks_pre_2021.parquet`, `blocks_post_2021.parquet`, and `dashboard/data/*.json` directly in the browser via `hyparquet` and visualizes them using `ECharts` (`dashboard/js/charts.js`).

## Key Files
- `/dashboard/index.html`: Core UI layout
- `/dashboard/js/data-loader.js`: Client-side Parquet & JSON loader
- `/dashboard/js/charts.js`: ECharts visualization logic
- `/dashboard/js/main.js`: Filter & profile interaction controller
- `/dashboard/data/lookup/pool_profiles.json`: 182 sourced pool profiles (synced from `mining-pools-data`)
- `/dashboard/data/lookup/timelines.json`: Editorial Bitcoin mining historical milestones
